body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Eager puppy teammate; warm reaction, one accessible idea, another chance. No baby talk. Voice direction: High female register with an American accent. Lightly textured springy voice and short expressive reactions; sincere excitement followed by a gentle practical explanation. Cute without baby talk. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Oh, there it is! That move leaves a piece with no defender. Let's check the reply together, then try to keep that piece protected.
